text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This isn't like you. Your poker face is
slipping.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Eek! Look away, pervert! ☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pervert?! Ugh, are you an idiot?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...If I know anything about you, it's that
you'll
analyze what happened today and
use that to
improve.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but I won't be the only one.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't dare. Keep going.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, I have no intention of losing, so
I'll see you
again at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gotcha.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Can you at least be a little serious?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Welp, I lost that one. Boo-hoo.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sounds good. I'm ready to win. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...That's what I wanna say, but it's not
gonna be
that easy.

She says this quietly while looking off to
the side
toward...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Finally, the Derby is next!

Special Week. Judging from the fiery
look in her
eyes, she's already prepared
for the next
challenge.
On the way back from the race...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a moment? There's
something I want
to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't tell me. Is this another
declaration of
war? Have you been
hanging out too much with
King?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'm here to declare war.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Running with you today... I realized how
strong
you are.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But... I really don't wanna lose the
Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gotta aim for that dream...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right. I wanna win the Derby and
become the
best Umamusume in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why the Derby will be mine! I'm gonna get better and better! Just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Dreams, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I bet she really is gonna get stronger.
Spe's got
that main character energy,
turning her hopes and
dreams into her
strength.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, when I see her do that... it
makes
me want to see her accomplish
those dreams.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm not saying I'm gonna let her win. It's
just that I
don't have some passion-filled
motivation like—
choice_data_list: でも、それじゃ君の夢は叶わない
でも、それじゃ貴方の夢は叶わない

text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There goes my phone...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hello?

text_block_list.name: Caller
text_block_list.text: SKYYY! YOU DID SO WELL!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Gramps! Turn it down a notch!

Sky panics and promptly creates some
distance
for some privacy. Even from far
away though, I
can hear the incredible
joy coming from the voice
on the line.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What's he so excited for? I lost.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Turns out he's happy I was simply
able to
run in a Classic.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's his dream to see me win the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure is. He's been bugging me about it
since I was
a little kid!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Picture kneeling down to a sweet,
innocent
Umamusume child and saying,
"You've got what it
takes to win the
Triple Crown." That's a lot.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Can't reel in a big fish without putting
your back
into it. Maybe it's time to get
serious, huh?

I think back to that rare moment when
she spoke
so earnestly. It seems her
grandfather's dream is
connected to her
decision to compete in the
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't think I'm trying to win this
just for him,
okay? 'Cause I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's good I can show him the races he
always
dreamt I would run.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's good I have the chance to run in the
races he's
been hoping for.

Sky smiles softly. It's a touching moment,
but as
quickly as it came...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Can't get rewarded for winning the
Classics if he's
not around to see it, am I
right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's why I run—for me, myself
and I.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm not like Spe and the others... I don't
have a
beautiful dream or some deep
reason to win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You may be right, but don't say that out
loud.
choice_data_list: 勝ちたい気持ちに優劣はない
勝ちたい気持ちに優劣はないよ

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... who cares anyway? Even a slacker
like
me...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Can win the Japanese Derby!
